sections.title: Romantic and Victorian Poetry
sections.description: This course will focus on (mostly) British poetry from the early Romantic period through the late Victorian era on the edge of modernism. We will practice different ways of reading as we discuss major and minor works in various forms, meters, and genres, along with significant movements in poetics and the social worlds that made them. See the English Department's website at www.english.upenn.edu for a description of the current offerings.
